issue_context.title: Files doesn't work with my cooperate (company) PC
issue_context.body:
### Description

After installed, I noticed that following function is not working in my cooperate PC:
 - System context menu doesn't show 3rd-party software like TotoiseSVN
 - OneDrive for Business folder is not displayed in Left-Side Bar (is this feature not implemented?)
 - Run "Open in Terminal..." is not working
 
I supposed that the following application installed in my PC may conflict with Files, but I hope you can check detail from log file:
 - Carbon Black Cloud Sensor
 - Trend Micro Apex One
 - System Group Policy may be controlled by my cooperate




### Steps To Reproduce

1. Right click on empty area of a folder
2. Check the Left-side bar
3. Right click on a folder, then select "Open in Terminal..."



### Expected behavior

1. Context menu item for 3rd-party software like TotoiseSVN should show up
2. OneDrive for Business should show up
3. Command Prompt window should open


### Files Version

Version: 2.0.13.0 OS Version: 10.0.18363.1556

### Windows Version

Windows 10 Pro 1909, Build 18363.1556
